title: Topological Edge States from Molecular Chirality: A General Framework for Dimerized Dipolar Arrays
summary: We establish a general theoretical framework for realizing topological edge states in dimerized arrays of chiral dipolar molecules and demonstrate that molecular handedness provides a natural and tunable route to SSH-like topology in an interacting one-dimensional setting.
